notes: The BASIC text-to-image graph for the sdxl-fp8 catalog entry (WORKPLAN 18 P7c step 2g, NEXT UP 5a-4g/5a-4h). It is AE_LLAMA_SDXL_T2I_V1 with the UNet loaded a second way and nothing else: same seven nodes, same ids, same checkpoint FILE, same 1024x1024, same euler/normal/20 steps/cfg 8. Node 8 is core UNETLoader reading the UNet out of that same checkpoint with weight_dtype fp8_e4m3fn, and KSampler.model takes it instead of node 1's MODEL output; node 1 still supplies CLIP and VAE. Node 7's filename_prefix differs so the two entries' outputs do not land in one folder. Everything the sibling manifest says about the single CLIPTextEncode, the latent and the missing procedural.resolution applies here unchanged; read AE_LLAMA_SDXL_T2I_V1.manifest.json for it rather than trusting a paraphrase.
whyUNETLoaderOnACheckpoint: UNETLoader is the only core node that casts weights on load (CheckpointLoaderSimple takes no dtype, the wall 5b hit on LTX). The vendor comfy/sd.py load_diffusion_model_state_dict pulls the diffusion model out of a whole checkpoint ('Allow loading unets from checkpoint files'), so no UNet-only file is needed. UNETLoader lists only the diffusion_models folders, so the panel's extra_model_paths.yaml maps every checkpoints folder it knows as a diffusion_models folder too, after the real one (comfy.js pushModelSubs). A backend the panel did NOT write that yaml for will not offer the name, and the preflight then refuses naming where the file sits on disk.
whyItIsASiblingAndNotASetting: Same answer as the Wan and H3 pairs: the catalog entry is what the panel prices, gates and recommends on, and these two carry different minVramGB (8 vs 12). One template with the dtype swapped at run time would make one workflowTemplate answer for two floors.
quality: A cast shifts the denoise path, so seed 12345 is a different SAMPLE, not a degraded one: SSIM 0.77 / PSNR 15.6 dB against the fp16 png at seed 12345, 0.87 at seed 777, both pairs looked at (same scene, light and cleanliness, a different car body). fp8_e4m3fn and not _fast, for the reason AE_LLAMA_WAN22_5B_FP8_T2V_V1.manifest.json gives: storage only, the compute path left alone.

prompt.note: reached by introspection anyway (KSampler.positive/negative -> the CLIPTextEncode pair); named so a reader does not have to derive it.

models.note: ONE file read by two loaders: CheckpointLoaderSimple for CLIP + VAE, UNETLoader for the fp8-cast UNet. Listed once, in checkpoints where the downloader puts it, so a buyer who has sdxl already has this and nothing is fetched twice.
